current_prompt.body:
EXECUTE the First Fit algorithm on the provided item sequence with bin capacity C = 10 and PRODUCE the resulting bin packing.
DETERMINE the optimal packing that uses the fewest possible bins for the same items and capacity.
COMPUTE the gap between the number of bins used by the First Fit result and the optimal result.
EXPLAIN why the arrival order of items leads to a higher bin count in the First Fit outcome.
INCLUDE a SELF‑TEST that VERIFIES both the First Fit packing and the optimal packing USE every item exactly once and RESPECT the capacity constraint of C = 10.
